packageRules.description: The modules of this repository (the parent poms of the child modules) only exist here, so there is nothing to look up on Maven Central; without this rule the dashboard reports package lookup failures
Merge patch updates of dependencies once the required build check (which runs the tests) passes. Minor and major updates are never merged automatically: each version gets its own PR for review

Merge minor updates of the build tools (Maven plugins, Tycho, Maven in the build workflow) and of the test dependency (mockito) once the required build check passes, but not before a release is 3 days old. Runtime dependencies (guava, gson) are not listed: they ship with the plugin and keep one PR per version for review
Merge all GitHub Actions updates, majors included, once the required build check passes, but not before a release is 3 days old; main only accepts squash merges
